mainQuests.title: The Ledger of the Lost Town
mainQuests.description: You wake up in a village where memory is currency. The Elder hands you a dusty ledger. 'To see the path ahead, you must first record where you stand.' Log your first expense in the Finance Office to clear the fog around the village gates.

mainQuests.title: The Toll of the Glutton
mainQuests.description: Gorgos the Swallower, a massive toad-like beast, blocks the bridge to the mainland. He demands a 'memory toll' from all travelers. Defeat him to re-open the Trade Routes of Copper.

sideQuests.title: The Impulse Kraken
sideQuests.description: A sea beast made of 'Wasted Gold' is harrying the coast. Drive it back to find the Aegis of the Reserve.

mainQuests.title: The Contract of the Frost-Wraith
mainQuests.description: Sanguis the Creditor haunts the mountains with 'Eternal Interest' contracts. Burn his book of contracts to restore the world's flow of magic.

sideQuests.title: The Audit of the Innkeeper
sideQuests.description: The local innkeeper's 'Seeds of Future Growth' have been stolen. Help him find them to earn the Staff of Compound Clarity.

mainQuests.title: The Auditor's Final Judgment
mainQuests.description: The Iron Sentinel stands before the Gilded Spire, judging every soul's 'worth.' Use the Ledger of Truth to override its logic and open the Vault Gates.
